snippet.title: Blood Covenant | Official Next Fest Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The night shift is hiring. Play the free Blood Covenant demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.
▶ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818530/Blood_Covenant/

Blood Covenant is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror job-sim. You and your crew are hazmat cleaners taking the jobs nobody else will: farmhouses, barns in the woods and a psychiatric hospital with a history no one talks about. Scrub the blood, bag what's left, seal the breaches and repair the fences, then get back to the van before whatever moved in comes for you. Spot what's changed, read what's written on the walls under UV, and name the thing you're dealing with before you light the altar. Name the wrong one and it comes for you instead.

📅 Free demo: Steam Next Fest, Oct 19-26, 2026
📅 Full release: January 5, 2027
⭐ Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818530/Blood_Covenant/

Developer & publisher: DelaJea Press
Music: "Omen" by Ruskerdax (CC0), opengameart.org/content/omen

#BloodCovenant #SteamNextFest #CoopHorror #IndieHorror #HorrorGame
